_aprasas: Brėžly sąsajos tekstai anglų kalba. Raktas - lietuviškas tekstas, kaip matomas ekrane; # - bet koks skaičius, {} - bet koks tekstas (verčiamas atskirai). Naujus tekstus pridėk čia; neišversti lieka lietuviški.

tekstai.Ši juosta rodo, kiek žingsnių jau padare: This bar shows how many steps you have done.
tekstai.Aprašyk, kas nutiko. Sukursiu failą su i: Describe what happened. I'll create a file with information about Brėžly and AutoCAD that you can send to the developer.
tekstai.Atidaro atsakymą atskirame faile: Opens the answer in a separate file
tekstai.Atliktos pamokos, testai, praktikos uždu: Completed lessons, tests, practice tasks and XP - print it or save as PDF.
tekstai.Atsisiųsk vieną failą su visomis kortelė: Download one file with all the cards and the test. Send it to your phone - it opens in the browser even offline.
tekstai.Atsisiųsti failą telefonui: Download the file for your phone
tekstai.AutoCAD komandų eilutė - įvesk geltonus: AutoCAD command line - type the yellow answers
tekstai.Be užuominų - pilni taškai. Įstrigus - u: No hints - full points. Stuck? A hint or „Show me“.
tekstai.Braižysi tu pats, o aš parodysiu, kur ką: You will draw yourself, and I'll show you where to click and check your work.
tekstai.Brėžly dabar atrodo kaip tikra CAD progr: Brėžly now looks like a real CAD program - easier on the eyes and more serious for coursework.
tekstai.Brėžly dešinėje, AutoCAD kairėje - nieka: Brėžly on the right, AutoCAD on the left - nothing covered
tekstai.Brėžly parodo, ką įvesti AutoCAD komandų: Brėžly shows what to type in the AutoCAD command line and explains why.
tekstai.Bus sukurta ataskaita su tavo pamokomis,: A report with your lessons, tests and practice tasks will be created. It opens in your browser, where you can print it or save it as PDF (Ctrl+P).
tekstai.Eksportuok čia, nusikopijuok failą (USB,: Export here, copy the file (USB, email, OneDrive) and click „Import“ on the other computer.
tekstai.Jei tavo AutoCAD ne anglų kalba: _LINE,: If your AutoCAD is not in English: _LINE, _CIRCLE work in any language.
tekstai.Kas kelias sekundes pažiūriu į brėžinį i: Every few seconds I look at the drawing and notice a finished step myself.
tekstai.Kiekvienas lygis - nauja apranga. XP gau: Every level brings a new outfit. You earn XP for lesson steps and tests.
tekstai.Mirksi, seka pelę akimis, džiaugiasi ir: Blinks, follows the mouse with its eyes, celebrates and gets sad together with you.
tekstai.Nepriklausoma programa, nesusijusi su Au: An independent program, not affiliated with Autodesk, Inc. AutoCAD® is a trademark of Autodesk, Inc.
tekstai.Nešiojamam kompiuteriui: „Šalia AutoCAD“: For laptops: „Next to AutoCAD“ splits the screen, „Mini“ is a small card over AutoCAD.
Shows where to click and cheers you on.
tekstai.Pasikartok komandas ir teoriją, kai Auto: Review commands and theory when AutoCAD isn't at hand.
tekstai.Pasirink personažą ir aprenk jį. Nauji d: Choose a character and dress it up. New items unlock as you learn: for levels, badges, lessons and your study streak.
tekstai.Pvz.: # pamokos # žingsnis sako „ne taip: E.g.: lesson # step # says „not right“ although I drew it correctly.
tekstai.Stebiu tavo brėžinį - kai padarysi, past: I'm watching your drawing - when you're done, I'll notice.
tekstai.Stebiu tavo brėžinį ir pats pastebiu, ka: I watch your drawing and notice when a step is done. You can also click „Check“ - I'll tell you what's wrong.
tekstai.Sukursiu failą su informacija - atsiųsk: I'll create a file with the details - send it to the developer.
Dark is easier on the eyes in the evening.
tekstai.Tavo pažanga vienoje kortelėje - atsisių: Your progress on one card - download it and show your friends.
tekstai.Tikri brėžiniai su rėmeliu: 2D - A4 lapa: Real drawings with a border: 2D - A4 sheet, 3D - A3 sheet. Open a blank sheet in AutoCAD, draw it and I'll check.
tekstai.Viskas kita liko: pamokos, praktika, tik: Everything else stays: lessons, practice, checking, XP and your progress.
tekstai.XP, pamokos ir daiktai saugomi faile - i: XP, lessons and items are saved in a file - they stay even if you reinstall Brėžly.
tekstai.oranžinė - veiksmas, žalia - priimta, ra: orange - action, green - accepted, red - fix it, blue - information.
tekstai.„Šalia AutoCAD“ režime AutoCAD sumažinam: In „Next to AutoCAD“ mode AutoCAD is resized to the remaining space so Brėžly doesn't cover the drawing.
tekstai.Veikia ir kai dirbi AutoCAD'e:: Works while you are in AutoCAD too:
Language of the Brėžly interface and lessons.
Brėžly will do this step in AutoCAD itself. You won't get XP for it, but you can watch and continue. Show it?
tekstai.Ištrinti visą progresą, XP ir daiktus?: Delete all progress, XP and items?
tekstai.Pakeisti dabartinį progresą šiuo (# XP)?: Replace the current progress with this one (# XP)? The current one will be overwritten.
tekstai.Sukurti naują brėžinį AutoCAD'e: Create a new drawing in AutoCAD
This can take up to a minute.
tekstai.AutoCAD LT neleidžia programoms valdyti: AutoCAD LT doesn't let programs work with the drawing, so Brėžly can't check it. You need full AutoCAD (free for students).
tekstai.Pirmiausia prisijunk prie AutoCAD (mygtu: Connect to AutoCAD first (button at the bottom left).
tekstai.Paleidžiu AutoCAD - tai gali užtrukti ik: Starting AutoCAD - this can take up to a minute ⏳
tekstai.Atidarytas naujas brėžinys iš acadiso.dw: Opened a new drawing from acadiso.dwt
tekstai.Pradėsim nuo pradžių: failas, kampinis į: We'll start from the beginning: file, title block, 2D drawing...
tekstai.Pradėsim nuo pamokos „2D brėžinys“. Prie: We'll start with the lesson „2D drawing“. You can go back to the first two any time.
